In brief

Given Mulligan’s penchant for bawdy profanity, "I'm melting, as the candle remarked" should almost certainly be heard as a dildo joke.

At more length

After this initial sally into the realm of female genitalia, he quickly moves on to talk about the urination of Mother Grogan and Mary Ann. In Scylla and Charybdis he will gaily introduce a dramatic script: “Everyman His own Wife or A Honeymoon in the Hand (a national immorality in three orgasms).” In Oxen of the Sun he proposes “a national fertilising farm” marked by an obelisk where women hankering after offspring can come for free insemination, and jokes about the prodigious erections of Roman centurions.

John Hunt 2011
